{{Color|Legendary}} |contains = 5 }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Dive deep and double check your oxygen levels!|Shop Description}} }} ==Description== The '''Scuba Ops Crate''' is a seasonal skincrate that was released for the Summer of 2026. This crate yields 5 scuba-themed skins. It can be purchased for {{Coins|4,500}} in the store, or for {{Robux|199}}. Each skin that can be obtained from the '''Scuba Ops Crate''' has a rarity which affects how likely you are to unlock the skin and the price when it appears in the Daily Skin Store. In the Daily Skin Store, {{Color|Common}} skins cost {{Coins|4,500}}, {{Color|Uncommon}} skins cost {{Coins|5,250}}, {{Color|Rare}} skins cost {{Coins|6,500}} and {{Color|Legendary}} skins cost {{Coins|10,000}}. ==Appearance== The '''Scuba Ops Crate''' is a dark grey crate with red lines on it.
